words.enDefinition: A written account of an event and its circumstances

examples.en: The hall manager wrote an incident report about the damaged common room.
examples.zh: 宿舍管理员就公共休息室受损写了一份「事故报告」。

examples.en: I read the incident report before sending it to the accommodation office.
examples.zh: 我先阅读了「事故报告」，然后才发给住宿办公室。

collocations: a copy of an incident report

words.enDefinition: A chronological record of incidents kept by an organization

examples.en: The residence office added a short entry to its incident log.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室在「事故登记日志」里简短地记了一笔。

examples.en: The adviser checked which date appeared in our incident log.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了我们「事故登记日志」上写的是哪一天。

collocations: an entry in an incident log

words.enDefinition: The day on which the event being recorded took place

examples.en: The form showed the date of incident separately from the reporting date.
examples.zh: 表格把「事故发生日期」与报告日期分开列了出来。

examples.en: I checked the date of incident against the earlier message from reception.
examples.zh: 我把「事故发生日期」和前台早先发来的消息核对了一下。

words.enDefinition: The time when the reported event is believed to have occurred

examples.en: The office asked whether the time of incident was exact or approximate.
examples.zh: 办公室问「事故发生时间」是准确记录还是估计的。

examples.en: I added a short note next to the time of incident field.
examples.zh: 我在「事故发生时间」一栏旁加了一条简短备注。

words.enDefinition: The time when someone first noticed damage or a loss

examples.en: I wrote down the time of discovery beside the description of the damage.
examples.zh: 我在受损情况描述旁记下了「发现受损的时间」。

examples.en: The manager read back the time of discovery during our follow-up meeting.
examples.zh: 后续会面时，管理员复述了「发现受损的时间」。

words.enDefinition: An account listing related events in the order they happened

examples.en: I prepared a timeline of events from the notes my flatmates sent.
examples.zh: 我根据室友发来的记录整理了一份「事件时间线」。

examples.en: The timeline of events helped us remember which room was checked first.
examples.zh: 「事件时间线」帮我们想起来最先检查的是哪个房间。

words.enDefinition: A written description of what happened in a particular event

examples.en: The accommodation officer asked me for a written account of the leak.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室的工作人员请我提供漏水事件的「书面经过说明」。

examples.en: I kept my written account with the other records from that week.
examples.zh: 我把「书面经过说明」与那一周的其他记录一起存放。

words.enDefinition: A description from someone who directly experienced or observed an event

examples.en: The report included a firsthand account from a student who saw the damage.
examples.zh: 报告里有一位看到受损情况的学生提供的「亲历者的陈述」。

examples.en: The coordinator asked which part of my statement was a firsthand account.
examples.zh: 协调员问我的陈述中哪部分是「亲历者的陈述」。

collocations: a firsthand account of the event

words.enDefinition: A person's account of what they saw or heard during an event

examples.en: The residence team attached a witness statement to its written report.
examples.zh: 住宿团队在书面报告后面附了一份「证人陈述」。

examples.en: My flatmate checked the date before handing in her witness statement.
examples.zh: 室友在交「证人陈述」之前核对了日期。

words.enDefinition: A later report giving updates about an event already recorded

examples.en: The property office sent a follow-up report after checking the room again.
examples.zh: 物业办公室再次查看房间后，发来一份「后续情况报告」。

examples.en: I compared the follow-up report with the original message from reception.
examples.zh: 我把「后续情况报告」与前台最初发来的消息作了比较。

collocations: a follow-up report about the incident

words.enDefinition: A report changed after the original account was recorded

examples.en: I checked what had changed in the amended incident report I received.
examples.zh: 我查看了收到的「修订后的事故报告」里改了什么。

examples.en: The office kept the amended incident report alongside the earlier written version.
examples.zh: 办公室把「修订后的事故报告」和较早的版本放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: Physical harm caused to buildings, belongings, or other things

examples.en: The form listed property damage in the section about my dorm room.
examples.zh: 表格在宿舍房间一栏记录了「财产损坏」情况。

examples.en: The hall manager checked what property damage was described in the report.
examples.zh: 宿舍管理员核对了报告记录的是哪项「财产损坏」。

words.enDefinition: Physical harm or residue caused to property by exposure to smoke

examples.en: The maintenance note listed smoke damage in the shared laundry room.
examples.zh: 维护记录写着公共洗衣房有「烟熏损坏」。

examples.en: The assessor pointed out which photos showed the smoke damage.
examples.zh: 评估人员指出哪几张照片显示了「烟熏损坏」。

collocations: a room affected by smoke damage

words.enDefinition: Physical harm to property caused directly by fire

examples.en: The building report described fire damage in a storage area downstairs.
examples.zh: 大楼报告描述了楼下储物区的「火灾损坏」。

examples.en: I asked which page contained the description of the fire damage.
examples.zh: 我问哪一页写了「火灾损坏」的情况。

words.enDefinition: How much property was damaged and how seriously it was affected

examples.en: The inspection report described the extent of damage on two separate pages.
examples.zh: 检查报告用了两页来描述「受损范围与程度」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the extent of damage was clear from the photos.
examples.zh: 顾问问，从照片上能不能看清「受损范围与程度」。

words.enDefinition: Physical harm that can be seen without further examination

examples.en: The assessor marked the visible damage beside the lower corner of the door.
examples.zh: 评估人员标出了门下角旁边「可见的损坏」。

examples.en: The form had a space for a brief description of visible damage.
examples.zh: 表格留了一栏，用来简述「可见的损坏」。

words.enDefinition: Physical harm not apparent during a basic look at property

examples.en: The later report referred to hidden damage behind the panel.
examples.zh: 后来的报告提到了面板背后的「隐蔽损坏」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why the form mentioned possible hidden damage separately.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了表格为什么单独提到可能存在的「隐蔽损坏」。

words.enDefinition: Things owned by someone that were harmed in an incident

examples.en: We wrote down the damaged belongings before speaking to the property office.
examples.zh: 与物业办公室沟通之前，我们记下了「受损的个人物品」。

examples.en: I checked whether my scarf was included among the damaged belongings.
examples.zh: 我核对了围巾有没有列入「受损的个人物品」。

words.enDefinition: A detailed list identifying property or items that were harmed

examples.en: The damage inventory listed the desk beside the other affected items.
examples.zh: 「受损物品清单」在其他受影响物品旁列出了书桌。

examples.en: I checked which room each item belonged to on the damage inventory.
examples.zh: 我查看了「受损物品清单」，核对每项物品原来在哪间房。

collocations: a copy of the damage inventory

words.enDefinition: Expenses for storing belongings elsewhere for a limited period

examples.en: The statement listed temporary storage costs in a separate section from repairs.
examples.zh: 说明把「临时寄存费用」和维修费用分开列在不同栏目。

examples.en: I asked which dates the temporary storage costs covered for our furniture.
examples.zh: 我问我们家具的「临时寄存费用」涵盖哪些日期。

words.enDefinition: Information describing an item, such as its model or condition

examples.en: I checked the item details before sending the list to the insurer.
examples.zh: 我核对了「物品详细信息」，才把清单发给保险公司。

examples.en: The form had one section for item details and another for photos.
examples.zh: 表格一栏填「物品详细信息」，另一栏放照片。

words.enDefinition: The date an item was bought by its owner

examples.en: I found the purchase date near the top of my old receipt.
examples.zh: 我在旧收据靠近顶部的地方找到了「购买日期」。

examples.en: The insurer asked which document showed the purchase date for the bicycle.
examples.zh: 保险公司问，哪份文件写有这辆自行车的「购买日期」。

words.enDefinition: An examination of property to see where and how it was affected

examples.en: The property office arranged a damage inspection after the leak was reported.
examples.zh: 接到漏水报告后，物业办公室安排了「受损检查」。

examples.en: The form listed the date of the damage inspection under the address.
examples.zh: 表格在地址下方列了「受损检查」的日期。

collocations: a report from a damage inspection

words.enDefinition: An assessment made by someone separate from the parties directly involved

examples.en: The insurer listed an independent assessment separately from the early report.
examples.zh: 保险公司把「独立评估」与早期报告分开列出了。

examples.en: I asked which engineer had completed the independent assessment for our room.
examples.zh: 我问哪位工程师完成了我们房间的「独立评估」。

collocations: the findings of an independent assessment

words.enDefinition: A dwelling reported to be unsuitable for people to live in

examples.en: The accommodation office described the flat as an uninhabitable unit in its report.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室在报告中将该公寓称为「无法居住的住宅」。

examples.en: The coordinator asked which residents had been assigned to the uninhabitable unit.
examples.zh: 协调员问原先有哪些住户被分到这个「无法居住的住宅」。

collocations: a notice describing an uninhabitable unit

words.enDefinition: A request for insurance payment or help after property loss

examples.en: I asked which report belonged with my property insurance claim for the desk.
examples.zh: 我问哪份报告应该和书桌的「财产保险理赔申请」放在一起。

examples.en: Our adviser checked the date on my property insurance claim summary.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了我的「财产保险理赔申请」概要上的日期。

collocations: documents for a property insurance claim

words.enDefinition: A request under insurance for lost or damaged personal belongings

examples.en: I checked which items were listed on the contents claim.
examples.zh: 我核对了「室内财物理赔申请」上列了哪些物品。

examples.en: The insurer discussed my contents claim separately from the building repair.
examples.zh: 保险公司把我的「室内财物理赔申请」和楼房维修分开谈。

collocations: a contents claim for damaged belongings

words.enDefinition: An initial report informing an insurer that a loss occurred

examples.en: The insurer listed the first notice of loss separately from my later statement.
examples.zh: 保险公司把「首次报损通知」与我后来的陈述分开列出。

examples.en: I checked the first notice of loss for the date of our call.
examples.zh: 我核对了「首次报损通知」上记录的通话日期。

collocations: record the first notice of loss
receive a first notice of loss
details in a first notice of loss

words.enDefinition: A formal statement or document describing the loss being claimed

examples.en: The insurer showed where proof of loss was named on the checklist.
examples.zh: 保险公司指出了清单上「损失证明材料」的位置。

examples.en: I kept the proof of loss with the list of damaged items.
examples.zh: 我把「损失证明材料」与受损物品清单放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: A person who investigates a loss and assesses an insurance claim

examples.en: The claims adjuster asked which items had been in the room.
examples.zh: 「保险理赔查勘员」问原先有哪些物品放在房间里。

examples.en: I checked whether the claims adjuster had received the building report.
examples.zh: 我核对了「保险理赔查勘员」有没有收到大楼报告。

collocations: a report from a claims adjuster

words.zhGloss: 为投保人代理的公估师
words.enDefinition: A US professional who represents policyholders in property insurance claims
acceptedZhAnswers: 为投保人代理的公估师

examples.en: The US guide explained which party a public adjuster works for.
examples.zh: 美国指南说明了「为投保人代理的公估师」代表的是哪一方。

examples.en: I asked how the guide distinguished a public adjuster from the insurer's representative.
examples.zh: 我问指南怎样区分「为投保人代理的公估师」和保险公司的代表。

collocations: a report by a public adjuster

words.enDefinition: An insurer's decision about whether the reported loss falls under coverage

examples.en: The coverage decision explained which items were included in the review.
examples.zh: 「保险承保范围认定」说明了哪些物品纳入了审核。

examples.en: I read the coverage decision before discussing the repair estimate with reception.
examples.zh: 我先读了「保险承保范围认定」，再和前台谈维修费用估算。

words.enDefinition: An event falling within the terms of an insurance policy

examples.en: The guide explained what an insured event meant in that section.
examples.zh: 指南解释了那一节中的「承保事件」指什么。

examples.en: I checked which incident the insurer had listed as the insured event.
examples.zh: 我查看了保险公司把哪起事故列为「承保事件」。

words.enDefinition: A loss eligible for insurance coverage under applicable policy terms

examples.en: The letter listed the broken desk as a covered loss.
examples.zh: 信件把损坏的书桌列为「承保损失」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the report described the covered loss.
examples.zh: 我问报告哪部分描述了这项「承保损失」。

collocations: a payment for a covered loss
review whether it is a covered loss

words.enDefinition: A loss for which insurance coverage is not available

examples.en: The report identified an uninsured loss involving one piece of furniture.
examples.zh: 报告指出，有一件家具涉及「未获保险保障的损失」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the amount represented an uninsured loss.
examples.zh: 顾问问，这笔金额是不是「未获保险保障的损失」。

collocations: a record of an uninsured loss

words.enDefinition: A cause of damage insured under a particular policy

examples.en: The document named fire as a covered peril in its example.
examples.zh: 那份文件在示例中把火灾列为一种「承保的致损事件」。

examples.en: I checked which cause the insurer listed as a covered peril.
examples.zh: 我核对了保险公司把哪种损坏原因列为「承保的致损事件」。

words.enDefinition: An insurance policy covering losses caused by specified listed events

examples.en: The workshop showed a sample named-perils policy for personal property.
examples.zh: 讲座展示了一份为个人财物承保的「列明风险保单」样本。

examples.en: I checked how the named-perils policy described the listed risks.
examples.zh: 我核对了「列明风险保单」是怎样描述所列风险的。

collocations: a claim under a named-perils policy

words.enDefinition: A policy covering causes of loss unless excluded by its terms

examples.en: The sample open-perils policy had a separate section listing exclusions.
examples.zh: 「列明除外风险的保单」样本有单独一节列明除外事项。

examples.en: I asked what the document meant by an open-perils policy.
examples.zh: 我问文件中的「列明除外风险的保单」是什么意思。

collocations: a claim under an open-perils policy

words.enDefinition: A record of belongings kept in a house or flat

examples.en: My flatmate had a home inventory that included our furniture.
examples.zh: 室友有份「家中财物清单」，上面列了我们的家具。

examples.en: The assessor asked when we last updated the home inventory.
examples.zh: 评估人员问我们上次更新「家中财物清单」是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: the insurance value of property in its pre-loss condition, taking account of age and wear

examples.en: The insurer estimated the actual cash value of my desk after checking its age.
examples.zh: 保险公司核对书桌的使用年限后，估算了它的「实际现金价值」。

examples.en: The statement showed the actual cash value beside the cost of a new laptop.
examples.zh: 结算单把「实际现金价值」与购买一台新笔记本电脑的费用并排列出。

collocations: a payment based on actual cash value

words.enDefinition: A reduction in a valuation reflecting age, wear, or use

examples.en: The statement showed a depreciation deduction beside the amount for the sofa.
examples.zh: 说明在沙发金额旁列了一项「折旧扣减」。

examples.en: I asked why the depreciation deduction appeared on a separate line.
examples.zh: 我问为什么「折旧扣减」单独列出了一行。

words.enDefinition: Depreciation withheld initially that may later be paid under policy terms

examples.en: The US sample showed recoverable depreciation as a separate amount.
examples.zh: 美国样本把「可补偿的折旧额」单列为一笔金额。

examples.en: I asked where the letter described recoverable depreciation for that item.
examples.zh: 我问信件在何处说明了该物品的「可补偿的折旧额」。

words.enDefinition: the base amount a UK insurer requires the customer to pay toward a covered claim

examples.en: The UK insurer listed the compulsory excess in a separate line from the voluntary excess.
examples.zh: 英国保险公司将「固定自付免赔额」和自愿选择的免赔额分开列出。

examples.en: Our claim statement showed the compulsory excess before the amount payable by the insurer.
examples.zh: 我们的理赔结算单先列「固定自付免赔额」，再列保险公司应付的金额。

collocations: a compulsory excess on the policy

words.enDefinition: A policy's maximum amount for a single item of property

examples.en: I asked where the single-item limit was listed for personal belongings.
examples.zh: 我问个人物品的「单件物品赔付上限」列在哪儿。

examples.en: The example showed the single-item limit beside the overall amount.
examples.zh: 示例在总额旁列出了「单件物品赔付上限」。

words.enDefinition: Damage or loss treated as complete for insurance valuation purposes

examples.en: The report classified the damaged equipment as a total loss.
examples.zh: 报告把受损设备归为「全损」。

examples.en: I asked what total loss meant in the property assessment.
examples.zh: 我问财产评估中「全损」是什么意思。

collocations: record an item as a total loss
a report finding a total loss

words.enDefinition: Too costly to repair relative to the item's value

examples.en: The assessor described the damaged furniture as beyond economical repair in writing.
examples.zh: 评估人员在书面记录中把受损家具描述为「维修成本已不划算」。

examples.en: I saw beyond economical repair beside the desk on the summary.
examples.zh: 我在概要中的书桌一栏旁看到「维修成本已不划算」。

words.zhGloss: 无法使用财产期间的保障
words.enDefinition: Insurance protection for certain costs when damaged property cannot be used
acceptedZhAnswers: 无法使用财产期间的保障

examples.en: The claim sheet listed loss of use coverage beside receipts for temporary accommodation.
examples.zh: 理赔单在临时住宿收据旁列出了「无法使用财产期间的保障」。

examples.en: I asked which expenses came under loss of use coverage in the sample policy.
examples.zh: 我问保险示例里有哪些开支属于「无法使用财产期间的保障」。

collocations: a claim involving loss of use coverage
details of loss of use coverage

words.enDefinition: Extra costs of living away from an unusable insured home

examples.en: The statement had a separate section for additional living expenses.
examples.zh: 那份说明专设一节，列出了「额外生活开支」。

examples.en: I asked which documents related to additional living expenses while staying elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我问哪些文件与借住他处期间的「额外生活开支」有关。

collocations: a list of additional living expenses

words.enDefinition: A loss resulting indirectly from an incident or direct damage

examples.en: The adviser explained why the policy mentioned consequential loss separately.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么保单单独提到「间接损失」。

examples.en: I checked which example the guide called a consequential loss.
examples.zh: 我核对了指南把哪个示例称为「间接损失」。

words.enDefinition: A repair business an insurer has accepted for a claim

examples.en: The Australian insurer named an approved repairer in the message.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚保险公司在消息里列出了一家「认可的维修商」。

examples.en: I asked who the approved repairer would contact about our flat.
examples.zh: 我问「认可的维修商」会联系谁谈我们公寓的情况。

words.enDefinition: The specific tasks and areas included in proposed repair work

examples.en: The estimate set out the repair scope beneath the address.
examples.zh: 估价单在地址下方列出了「维修项目范围」。

examples.en: I asked whether our hallway appeared in the repair scope.
examples.zh: 我问「维修项目范围」里有没有我们那条走廊。

words.enDefinition: A document listing charges for repair work carried out

examples.en: I checked the address at the top of the repair invoice.
examples.zh: 我核对了「维修发票」顶部的地址。

examples.en: The office kept the repair invoice with the original estimate.
examples.zh: 办公室把「维修发票」和最初的估价单放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: An estimated price for replacing a damaged item or property

examples.en: I attached a replacement quote for the damaged study desk.
examples.zh: 我为受损书桌附上了一份「更换物品的报价」。

examples.en: The adviser asked when the replacement quote had been issued.
examples.zh: 顾问问这份「更换物品的报价」是什么时候出具的。

words.enDefinition: A claim resolution through payment rather than arranging work or replacement

examples.en: The insurer explained what the proposed cash settlement would cover.
examples.zh: 保险公司解释了拟议的「现金赔付结算」涵盖什么。

examples.en: I checked which amount the letter called the cash settlement.
examples.zh: 我核对了信件把哪个金额称为「现金赔付结算」。

words.enDefinition: Work organized by the insurer to repair damage accepted under a claim

examples.en: The letter described insurer-arranged repairs planned for the damaged hallway.
examples.zh: 信中介绍了为受损走廊计划的「保险公司安排的维修」。

examples.en: I asked which company was handling the insurer-arranged repairs that week.
examples.zh: 我问那一周由哪家公司负责「保险公司安排的维修」。

words.enDefinition: An itemized explanation of how a claim settlement amount was calculated

examples.en: I used the settlement breakdown to identify the amount for my desk.
examples.zh: 我查了「赔付金额明细」，确认其中分给书桌的金额。

examples.en: The settlement breakdown showed the repair and replacement amounts separately.
examples.zh: 「赔付金额明细」把维修与更换金额分开显示。

words.enDefinition: The collection of records kept about a particular insurance claim

examples.en: The insurer added the repair estimate to my claim file.
examples.zh: 保险公司把维修费用估算加入了我的「理赔档案」。

examples.en: I checked which report was already in the claim file.
examples.zh: 我核对了「理赔档案」里已经收录了哪份报告。

collocations: add a document to the claim file

words.enDefinition: A staff member who administers an insurance claim and its records

examples.en: My claims handler explained where the repair photos were listed.
examples.zh: 我的「理赔经办人员」说明了维修照片列在什么位置。

examples.en: I asked the claims handler who was reviewing the report.
examples.zh: 我问「理赔经办人员」是谁在审核报告。

collocations: an update from a claims handler

words.enDefinition: A report describing an adjuster's findings about an insurance loss

examples.en: I checked whether the adjuster's report described both of the rooms.
examples.zh: 我核对了「理赔查勘报告」是否描述了两个房间。

examples.en: The insurer said one photo was attached to the adjuster's report.
examples.zh: 保险公司说，有一张照片附在「理赔查勘报告」之后。

words.enDefinition: An assessment of the extent and financial value of a loss

examples.en: The loss assessment gave separate figures for the flooring and furniture.
examples.zh: 「损失评估」分别列出了地板和家具的估算金额。

examples.en: I checked which photographs the loss assessment referred to in that section.
examples.zh: 我核对了「损失评估」那一部分提到了哪些照片。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that an insurer is examining a claim

examples.en: The insurer's page showed claim under assessment beside the property entry.
examples.zh: 保险公司的页面在财物条目旁显示「理赔申请正在评估」。

examples.en: I saw the label claim under assessment after uploading the building report.
examples.zh: 上传大楼报告后，我看到了「理赔申请正在评估」这个标记。

collocations: a claim under assessment with an insurer
an update saying claim under assessment

words.enDefinition: A status indicating the adjuster's report has not been received

examples.en: The insurer said the file was awaiting the adjuster's report that week.
examples.zh: 保险公司说，那一周案卷处于「等待理赔查勘报告」的状态。

examples.en: I checked why the page said awaiting the adjuster's report for that item.
examples.zh: 我核对了网页为什么把那件物品标为「等待理赔查勘报告」。

collocations: a file awaiting the adjuster's report
a claim awaiting the adjuster's report
an update saying awaiting the adjuster's report

words.enDefinition: An update indicating an insurer is checking whether coverage applies

examples.en: The file displayed coverage under review below the list of affected items.
examples.zh: 案卷在受影响物品清单下面显示「保障范围正在审核」。

examples.en: The message said coverage under review and gave the handler's contact details.
examples.zh: 消息写着「保障范围正在审核」，附有经办人的联系方式。

collocations: a notice stating coverage under review
a file marked coverage under review
a status of coverage under review

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that a decision on authorizing repairs remains outstanding

examples.en: The property file showed repair approval pending beside the estimate we received.
examples.zh: 财产档案在我们收到的估价单旁显示「尚待维修批准」。

examples.en: I asked what repair approval pending meant in that part of the file.
examples.zh: 我问案卷那部分的「尚待维修批准」是什么意思。

collocations: an entry marked repair approval pending
a notice stating repair approval pending
a case marked repair approval pending

words.enDefinition: An additional request related to a loss already reported

examples.en: The letter explained which costs were listed in my supplemental claim.
examples.zh: 信件解释了我的「补充理赔申请」列出了哪些费用。

examples.en: I checked whether the supplemental claim was linked to the original report.
examples.zh: 我核对了「补充理赔申请」是否与原始报告关联。

words.enDefinition: To start considering an insurance claim again after closing it

examples.en: The insurer explained what it meant to reopen the claim on the portal.
examples.zh: 保险公司解释了其网站上「重新开启理赔案件」的意思。

examples.en: The handler said the office had decided to reopen the claim.
examples.zh: 经办人说，办公室已决定「重新开启理赔案件」。

collocations: a request to reopen the claim
an insurer may reopen the claim

words.enDefinition: A payment made before the final amount has been settled

examples.en: The insurer's account summary listed an interim payment on the second page.
examples.zh: 书面说明在第二页列出了一笔「理赔预付款」。

examples.en: I checked how the insurer labeled the interim payment on its statement.
examples.zh: 我核对了保险公司在说明中如何标注「理赔预付款」。

words.enDefinition: An agreement or decision resolving the remaining amounts in a claim

examples.en: The final settlement was listed separately from the earlier payment.
examples.zh: 「最终理赔结算」与先前的付款分开列出。

examples.en: I read the letter explaining the final settlement for my claim.
examples.zh: 我阅读了说明我的案件「最终理赔结算」的信件。

collocations: a letter giving the final settlement

words.enDefinition: Money paid to resolve a loss under an insurance claim

examples.en: The statement showed which item the settlement payment was for.
examples.zh: 说明写明了「理赔结算款」对应哪件物品。

examples.en: I checked the settlement payment against the amount on the letter.
examples.zh: 我把「理赔结算款」和信件上的金额核对了一下。

collocations: a notice about a settlement payment

words.enDefinition: A record or confirmation that a claim settlement was accepted

examples.en: The insurer filed the settlement acceptance separately from the payment notice.
examples.zh: 保险公司把「接受理赔结算方案」的记录与付款通知分开存档。

examples.en: I asked which date appeared on the settlement acceptance form.
examples.zh: 我问「接受理赔结算方案」的表格上写的是哪个日期。

words.enDefinition: A status showing that an earlier insurance claim was withdrawn

examples.en: The portal displayed claim withdrawn beside the older property entry.
examples.zh: 平台在较早的财物条目旁显示「理赔申请已撤回」。

examples.en: I checked which reference appeared next to claim withdrawn on the screen.
examples.zh: 我核对了屏幕上「理赔申请已撤回」旁显示的编号。

words.enDefinition: Costs that have not been repaid by another party

examples.en: The adviser asked which unreimbursed expenses remained in my records.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的记录里还有哪些「未获报销的开支」。

examples.en: My budget listed the unreimbursed expenses separately from routine living costs.
examples.zh: 我的预算表把「未获报销的开支」和日常生活开支分开列出。

words.enDefinition: Costs for which repayment may be available under the applicable terms

examples.en: The insurer described which recoverable costs were shown in its example.
examples.zh: 保险公司说明了示例里列出了哪些「可要求补偿的费用」。

examples.en: I asked why one item appeared under recoverable costs on the statement.
examples.zh: 我问说明上有一项为什么列在「可要求补偿的费用」下面。

words.enDefinition: Costs associated with limiting further loss after an incident

examples.en: The sample report listed mitigation expenses separately from the repair bill.
examples.zh: 报告样本将「减少后续损失的开支」与维修账单分开列出。

examples.en: I asked which costs the statement described as mitigation expenses.
examples.zh: 我问说明上哪些费用被描述为「减少后续损失的开支」。

words.enDefinition: A record confirming payment for a place to stay

examples.en: I found the accommodation receipt in the hotel's confirmation message.
examples.zh: 我在酒店的确认消息里找到了「住宿收据」。

examples.en: The adviser asked which nights the accommodation receipt covered that week.
examples.zh: 顾问问「住宿收据」涵盖那周哪几晚。

collocations: a copy of the accommodation receipt

words.enDefinition: An insurance request concerning losses caused by interrupted travel plans

examples.en: The insurance app listed my travel disruption claim under the trip dates.
examples.zh: 保险应用在出行日期下面列出了我的「旅行中断理赔申请」。

examples.en: I asked which letter belonged with the travel disruption claim for that trip.
examples.zh: 我问哪封信应当和那趟出行的「旅行中断理赔申请」放在一起。

collocations: documents for a travel disruption claim

words.enDefinition: Insurance covering specified losses when a trip already underway is cut short

examples.en: The policy booklet described trip interruption cover in its travel section.
examples.zh: 保单手册在旅行一节介绍了「旅途中断保障」。

examples.en: I asked where the summary defined trip interruption cover for that trip.
examples.zh: 我问概要哪里定义了那次行程的「旅途中断保障」。

collocations: a policy with trip interruption cover

words.enDefinition: A policy benefit for certain costs arising from delayed travel

examples.en: The policy table showed a travel delay benefit under a separate heading.
examples.zh: 保单表格在单独的标题下列了「旅行延误保险给付」。

examples.en: I checked which expenses were listed beside the travel delay benefit.
examples.zh: 我查看了「旅行延误保险给付」旁列出了哪些费用。

collocations: a claim for a travel delay benefit

words.enDefinition: Money paid back by a transport company after a disruption

examples.en: The insurer listed the carrier reimbursement separately from its own payment.
examples.zh: 保险公司把「承运方退还的费用」和自己的赔付分开列出。

examples.en: I checked which expenses the carrier reimbursement covered on my statement.
examples.zh: 我核对了账单，确认「承运方退还的费用」对应哪些开支。

words.enDefinition: Travel costs that a provider will not pay back

examples.en: The form listed non-refundable travel expenses in a section about unused bookings.
examples.zh: 表格在未使用的预订一节列出了「不可退款的旅行开支」。

examples.en: My adviser explained which receipts related to non-refundable travel expenses for the trip.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了哪些收据与这次「不可退款的旅行开支」有关。

collocations: a list of non-refundable travel expenses

words.enDefinition: Travel costs that were paid before the relevant service took place

examples.en: I added the hotel booking to my list of prepaid travel expenses.
examples.zh: 我把酒店预订写进了「预付的旅行开支」清单。

examples.en: The adviser checked which prepaid travel expenses were shown on my statement.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了我的消费明细上有哪些「预付的旅行开支」。

words.enDefinition: Reservations for services that the customer did not end up using

examples.en: I separated the unused bookings from the services I had used.
examples.zh: 我把「未使用的预订」与我实际使用过的服务分开列出。

examples.en: The insurer checked which unused bookings were named in the report.
examples.zh: 保险公司核对了报告中列出了哪些「未使用的预订」。

words.enDefinition: The sum of money someone requests in an insurance claim

examples.en: I checked the amount claimed against the repair estimate I submitted.
examples.zh: 我把「申请赔付金额」与我提交的维修费用估算核对了一下。

examples.en: The amount claimed appeared separately from the insurer's own estimate.
examples.zh: 「申请赔付金额」与保险公司自己的估算分开列出。

words.enDefinition: Costs that meet the stated requirements for payment or reimbursement

examples.en: I asked where the insurer had listed the eligible expenses.
examples.zh: 我问保险公司把「可纳入理赔的费用」列在什么地方。

examples.en: The statement gave two examples of eligible expenses for that trip.
examples.zh: 说明给出了该次行程两类「可纳入理赔的费用」示例。

words.enDefinition: A brief record grouping costs connected with a particular event

examples.en: I used my expense summary to explain the additional costs.
examples.zh: 我用自己的「开支汇总」来说明这些额外开支。

examples.en: The adviser kept the expense summary alongside the detailed receipts.
examples.zh: 顾问把「开支汇总」与详细收据放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: A person unable to stay in their usual residence after disruption

examples.en: The office arranged a meeting for each displaced resident that week.
examples.zh: 办公室为每位「被迫暂离住处的居民」安排了那周的会面。

examples.en: The coordinator asked which services a displaced resident might need initially.
examples.zh: 协调员问「被迫暂离住处的居民」起初可能需要哪些服务。

words.enDefinition: Moving people to another location for a limited period

examples.en: The housing team arranged temporary relocation while the rooms were unavailable.
examples.zh: 客房不能使用期间，住宿团队安排了「临时搬迁」。

examples.en: I asked what the email meant by temporary relocation for our floor.
examples.zh: 我问邮件里我们这一层的「临时搬迁」指什么。

words.enDefinition: Another place to stay when the original accommodation is unavailable

examples.en: The residence team offered alternative accommodation while the flat was being repaired.
examples.zh: 公寓维修期间，住宿团队提供了「替代住宿」。

examples.en: I checked how the notice described our alternative accommodation for that weekend.
examples.zh: 我核对了通知是怎样介绍我们那个周末的「替代住宿」的。

words.enDefinition: The organization of a place to stay during an emergency

examples.en: The university confirmed my emergency housing placement in a short message.
examples.zh: 学校发来一条简短消息，确认会给我「安排紧急住宿」。

examples.en: I asked which person had arranged the emergency housing placement for our group.
examples.zh: 我问是谁为我们这一行人「安排紧急住宿」。

collocations: details of an emergency housing placement

words.enDefinition: A change assigning a resident to a different room

examples.en: The office explained where our room reassignment appeared in the housing portal.
examples.zh: 办公室说明了我们的「重新分配房间」安排显示在住宿平台的什么位置。

examples.en: I received a short note confirming the room reassignment for my floor.
examples.zh: 我收到一条简短通知，确认我们这层会「重新分配房间」。

words.enDefinition: A document or credit used toward a place to stay

examples.en: The coordinator explained what the lodging voucher covered at that property.
examples.zh: 协调员解释了「住宿凭券」在那家住宿机构能用于什么。

examples.en: I checked which nights were named on the lodging voucher.
examples.zh: 我核对了「住宿凭券」上写的是哪几晚。

words.enDefinition: Help providing food or covering meals for people needing support

examples.en: The student centre listed meal assistance in its update to residents.
examples.zh: 学生中心在发给居民的动态中列出了「用餐援助」。

examples.en: I asked which office coordinated meal assistance for the affected group.
examples.zh: 我问哪个办公室协调为受影响的一行人提供「用餐援助」。

words.enDefinition: Assistance with essential living needs such as food or housing

examples.en: The university described basic needs support in a leaflet for affected residents.
examples.zh: 大学在发给受影响居民的说明单里介绍了「基本生活需求援助」。

examples.en: I checked who was handling basic needs support during the repairs.
examples.zh: 我核对了维修期间谁在负责「基本生活需求援助」。

words.enDefinition: A collection of items needed for personal washing and care

examples.en: The residence office offered a hygiene kit to each affected resident.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室为每位受影响的居民提供了一个「个人清洁用品包」。

examples.en: I asked which supplies were included in the hygiene kit that evening.
examples.zh: 我问当晚提供的「个人清洁用品包」里有哪些东西。

words.enDefinition: Sheets, covers, or other bedding supplied in place of existing items

examples.en: The accommodation team brought replacement bedding to our temporary room.
examples.zh: 住宿团队把「替换用床上用品」送到了我们的临时房间。

examples.en: The note said where the replacement bedding had been left for us.
examples.zh: 提示写明了给我们准备的「替换用床上用品」放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: Financial help provided to meet needs over a limited period

examples.en: The campus adviser discussed short-term financial assistance in our first meeting.
examples.zh: 校园顾问在第一次会面中谈到了「短期经济援助」。

examples.en: I asked where the leaflet described short-term financial assistance for affected residents.
examples.zh: 我问说明单哪里介绍了受影响居民的「短期经济援助」。

words.enDefinition: A person organizing support and communication after a disruptive incident

examples.en: The recovery coordinator introduced herself at the accommodation office that morning.
examples.zh: 「后续恢复协调员」那天早上在住宿办公室作了自我介绍。

examples.en: I asked which message came from the recovery coordinator for our building.
examples.zh: 我问哪条消息来自我们大楼的「后续恢复协调员」。

collocations: an update from the recovery coordinator

words.enDefinition: A group helping people manage the aftermath of an incident

examples.en: The recovery support team sent a single update to all affected residents.
examples.zh: 「恢复援助团队」给所有受影响的居民发了同一份动态。

examples.en: I asked where the recovery support team was meeting students that week.
examples.zh: 我问「恢复援助团队」那一周在哪里会见学生。

collocations: an update from the recovery support team

words.enDefinition: A connection made by staff to another service providing help

examples.en: The adviser arranged a support referral after our discussion about housing.
examples.zh: 谈完住宿问题后，顾问安排我「转介至援助服务」。

examples.en: I asked which office the support referral was recorded under.
examples.zh: 我问「转介至援助服务」的记录归在哪个办公室。

words.enDefinition: Help provided after an initial meeting or response to an incident

examples.en: The office described follow-up support in a letter after our meeting.
examples.zh: 会面结束后，办公室在信中介绍了「后续支持」。

examples.en: I asked who would provide follow-up support during the next week.
examples.zh: 我问接下来一周由谁提供「后续支持」。

words.zhGloss: 在工作人员陪同下进入
words.enDefinition: Permission to enter an area with a staff member present
acceptedZhAnswers: 在工作人员陪同下进入

examples.en: The building manager described supervised access in the message to residents.
examples.zh: 楼管在面向居民的消息中介绍了「在工作人员陪同下进入」的安排。

examples.en: I asked which room was listed for supervised access on the notice.
examples.zh: 我问通知上写的是哪个房间可以「在工作人员陪同下进入」。

words.enDefinition: A place made available for academic work for a limited period

examples.en: The library offered a temporary study space for residents from our hall.
examples.zh: 图书馆为我们宿舍的住户提供了「临时学习场所」。

examples.en: I checked the schedule for the temporary study space before my seminar.
examples.zh: 我在研讨课前查了「临时学习场所」的开放安排。

collocations: hours for a temporary study space

words.enDefinition: A laptop lent for temporary use by a service

examples.en: The student centre offered a loaner laptop while mine was unavailable.
examples.zh: 我的电脑用不了的时候，学生中心提供了一台「借用的笔记本电脑」。

examples.en: I checked where to return the loaner laptop after the workshop.
examples.zh: 我查了讲座结束后应该把「借用的笔记本电脑」还到哪里。

words.enDefinition: Keeping teaching and study going through a period of disruption

examples.en: The department explained how it would support academic continuity during repairs.
examples.zh: 院系说明了维修期间会怎样支持「学业持续开展」。

examples.en: The notice mentioned academic continuity alongside updates about the temporary rooms.
examples.zh: 通知在临时教室的动态旁提到了「学业持续开展」。

words.enDefinition: Room for changes in study arrangements to accommodate difficulties

examples.en: The adviser discussed academic flexibility after I explained the housing disruption.
examples.zh: 我说明住宿受到影响后，顾问谈到了「学业安排弹性」。

examples.en: The email described who would answer questions about academic flexibility.
examples.zh: 邮件说明了谁负责回答有关「学业安排弹性」的问题。

words.enDefinition: A student's explanation of how an incident affected their circumstances

examples.en: I used the student impact statement to explain why I missed class.
examples.zh: 我用「学生受影响情况说明」解释了缺课的原因。

examples.en: The adviser compared my student impact statement with the dates of the repairs.
examples.zh: 顾问把我的「学生受影响情况说明」与维修日期作了核对。

words.enDefinition: To create a record of why or when someone was absent

examples.en: The adviser showed me where to document an absence on the form.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看，表格哪个位置可以「记录缺席情况」。

examples.en: I asked which person could document an absence after the residence closure.
examples.zh: 我问宿舍关闭后，谁可以「记录缺席情况」。

collocations: a form to document an absence
ask how to document an absence

words.enDefinition: Evidence that an incident forced someone to leave their usual accommodation

examples.en: The adviser kept the notice as proof of displacement for the case.
examples.zh: 顾问把通知留作本案「无法居住原处的证明」。

examples.en: I asked which document the office used as proof of displacement.
examples.zh: 我问办公室使用哪份文件作为「无法居住原处的证明」。

collocations: a letter serving as proof of displacement

words.enDefinition: An outline of expected stages in recovering from an incident

examples.en: The recovery timeline listed the dates for updates about our rooms.
examples.zh: 「后续恢复时间安排」列出了发布房间情况动态的日期。

examples.en: I read the recovery timeline before checking my temporary housing details.
examples.zh: 我先读了「后续恢复时间安排」，再核对临时住宿详情。

words.enDefinition: Short-term work carried out before a more permanent repair

examples.en: The office described temporary repairs separately from the later building work.
examples.zh: 办公室把「临时维修」和后续的楼宇施工分开介绍。

examples.en: The first report listed temporary repairs that had already taken place.
examples.zh: 第一份报告列出了已经完成的「临时维修」。

words.enDefinition: Work still needed after other repair tasks have been completed

examples.en: The residence team sent a list of outstanding repairs that evening.
examples.zh: 住宿团队那天晚上发来一份「尚未完成的维修」清单。

examples.en: I asked which outstanding repairs affected access to the rooms upstairs.
examples.zh: 我问哪些「尚未完成的维修」影响进入楼上的房间。

words.enDefinition: A message confirming that a specified repair job is finished

examples.en: The office delivered a repair completion notice before updating the room assignment.
examples.zh: 办公室更新房间分配之前，送达了一份「维修完工通知」。

examples.en: I checked which rooms were named on the repair completion notice.
examples.zh: 我核对了「维修完工通知」上列了哪些房间。

words.enDefinition: A request for help with needs following a disruptive event

examples.en: The office acknowledged my recovery assistance application in a separate message.
examples.zh: 办公室另发了一条消息，确认收到了我的「事后恢复援助申请」。

examples.en: I checked the name on the recovery assistance application before meeting the adviser.
examples.zh: 见顾问之前，我核对了「事后恢复援助申请」上的姓名。

collocations: details of a recovery assistance application

words.enDefinition: An organized outline of support or work after a disruption

examples.en: The university shared its recovery plan with the residents' committee.
examples.zh: 大学与住户委员会分享了它的「后续恢复计划」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the recovery plan concerned our floor.
examples.zh: 我问「后续恢复计划」哪一部分涉及我们这层。

words.enDefinition: A meeting or update giving residents information about their situation

examples.en: The housing manager held a resident briefing in the student centre.
examples.zh: 住宿管理员在学生中心举办了一场「住户情况说明会」。

examples.en: I read the notes from the resident briefing after my class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我看了「住户情况说明会」的记录。

words.enDefinition: Needs for help that remain after an initial response

examples.en: The coordinator asked about continuing support needs during our meeting that week.
examples.zh: 协调员在那周的会面中询问了「仍需援助的事项」。

examples.en: The form had a separate place for continuing support needs after relocation.
examples.zh: 表格专门留了一栏，填写搬迁后「仍需援助的事项」。

collocations: a record of continuing support needs

words.enDefinition: A brief description of a reported event and its main facts

examples.en: The housing manager attached a short incident summary to the email.
examples.zh: 住宿管理员在邮件里附了一份简短的「事故概要」。

examples.en: I compared the incident summary with the earlier maintenance note.
examples.zh: 我把「事故概要」与早先的维护记录作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A written account of the type and appearance of physical damage

examples.en: The report included a description of damage beside each affected item.
examples.zh: 报告在每件受影响的物品旁边都写了「损坏情况描述」。

examples.en: I checked the description of damage against the assessor's notes for our room.
examples.zh: 我把「损坏情况描述」和评估人员对我们房间的记录核对了一下。

words.enDefinition: Work performed and supplies used, often listed as repair costs

examples.en: The invoice showed separate amounts for labour and materials at the bottom.
examples.zh: 发票底部把「人工与材料」的金额分开列出。

examples.en: I asked whether the repair total included both labour and materials.
examples.zh: 我问维修总额是否同时包括「人工与材料」。

collocations: a quote covering labour and materials

words.enDefinition: A document identifying a travel insurance policy and its insured travelers

examples.en: I checked the travel dates on my travel insurance certificate before the call.
examples.zh: 打电话之前，我核对了「旅行保险凭证」上的出行日期。

examples.en: The adviser asked what name appeared on my travel insurance certificate.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的「旅行保险凭证」上写的是哪个姓名。

collocations: a copy of the travel insurance certificate
details on the travel insurance certificate

words.enDefinition: A difference between items listed and those found or reported

examples.en: I noticed an inventory discrepancy while comparing the two property reports.
examples.zh: 我在对照两份财物报告时发现一处「物品清单不一致之处」。

examples.en: The assessor asked which item caused the inventory discrepancy in our records.
examples.zh: 评估人员问，我们的记录中哪件物品导致了这处「物品清单不一致之处」。

words.enDefinition: Insurance protection for a particular item listed in the policy

examples.en: The British policy listed specified item cover separately from the general contents section.
examples.zh: 英国这份保单把「列明物品的保险保障」与一般室内财物保障分开列出。

examples.en: I looked for my bicycle in the section on specified item cover.
examples.zh: 我在「列明物品的保险保障」一栏查找我的自行车。

collocations: a policy with specified item cover

words.enDefinition: Insurance for certain losses when a planned trip is cancelled

examples.en: The guide described trip cancellation cover in a section about unused bookings.
examples.zh: 指南在未使用的预订一节介绍了「行程取消保障」。

examples.en: My adviser asked which page explained the trip cancellation cover I had.
examples.zh: 顾问问哪一页解释了我保单里的「行程取消保障」。

collocations: a policy with trip cancellation cover

words.enDefinition: An insurance document listing details specific to a person's policy

examples.en: The insurer pointed out where the address appeared on my policy schedule.
examples.zh: 保险公司指给我看「保单明细表」上的地址写在哪里。

examples.en: I compared the dates on the policy schedule with the claim file.
examples.zh: 我把「保单明细表」上的日期与理赔档案作了核对。

words.enDefinition: The event or circumstance that brought about a reported loss

examples.en: The adjuster listed the cause of loss separately from the affected property.
examples.zh: 查勘员把「损失原因」与受影响的财物分开列出。

examples.en: I checked how the cause of loss was described in the final report.
examples.zh: 我核对了最终报告是怎样描述「损失原因」的。
